name: I Could Just Eat You Up
source:
Seiichi has been friends with Emi for at least two months. Over the two months it seems that they have begun to have feelings for each other. Will Seiichi and Emi have a good relationship? TWs: Blood and cannibalism.  

[From [url=http://bassnovel.com/games.php?t=name&cid=Ken-Ken]BASSNovel[/url]]
translation:
诚一和惠至少做了两个月的朋友。在这两个月里，他们似乎渐渐对彼此产生了感情。诚一和惠能拥有美好的关系吗？
内容警告：血腥与食人。

[译自[url=http://bassnovel.com/games.php?t=name&cid=Ken-Ken]BASSNovel[/url]]
